messages:
maria: Heads-up — starting onboard for equinox13b. weights staged at s3://redwood-models/equinox13b/staging/2234/ . Want quick sanity checks before we run the safetensors conversion & shard layout. main concerns: tokenizer quirks (HF vs our tokenizer), fp16 vs bf16 tag, and tensor-parallel layout (tp=2 expected). @jay can you eyeball shard names and tokenizer mapping?

maria: convert command I plan to run:
```\
python convert_checkpoint.py \\
  --src s3://redwood-models/equinox13b/raw/ \\
  --out s3://redwood-models/equinox13b/staging/2234/ \\
  --format safetensors --dtype fp16 --tp 2 --pp 1 \\
  --shard-name-pattern equinox13b-pp{pp}-tp{tp}-{idx:03d}.safetensors
```

jay: quick look — shard files present but one filename missing the .safetensors suffix: equinox13b-pp0-tp0-004 (no ext). that will break the safepack step. can you rename or re-upload that one? also tokenizer: the HF tokenizer has a <|pad|> token id 1, our tokenizer expects PAD=0. we need to remap ids in vocab.json or run a patch step.

katie: re: checksums — I'll run sha256 over all shards after convert and push manifest.json with checksums. CI will fail otherwise. ping me when convert starts and I'll add the manifest job to the pipeline.

diego: small note on KV cache ordering — when we pack shards for serving we expect KV tensors shaped [layers, seq_len, heads, head_dim] flattened per-shard. confirm that convert keeps the leading layer axis intact. last time a model had TP axis swapped and it caused 2x slower perf.

jay: +1 on layer-first. also watch for duplicated special tokens in tokenizer.json (extra ``<|endoftext|>`` entry appeared in a previous model). run this check:
```\
python -c "import json; t=json.load(open('tokenizer.json')); print([k for k,v in t['added_tokens'].items() if v['id'] in (0,1)])"\
```

maria: thanks — I'll fix the missing ext and run a small remap script for PAD id. will kick convert in ~15m. Katie — I'll tag the convert job with pipeline:conversion:equinox13b-2234 so you can auto-attach manifest job.

artifact-bot: build queued: convert-equinox13b-2234 (estimate 12m). status: queued.

katie: when job finishes please post manifest link. also make sure model config includes explicit dtype string ("fp16") — our serving infra rejects ambiguous float types.

maria: noted. config snippet I'll write into model_card.json:
```\
{\n  "model": "equinox13b",\n  "dtype": "fp16",\n  "tensor_parallel": 2,\n  "pipeline_parallel": 1,\n  "shard_pattern": "equinox13b-pp{pp}-tp{tp}-{idx:03d}.safetensors"\n}\n```

jay: after convert, I'll run a tiny inference smoke test with kv-cache to ensure shapes are sane. should be ~5-10 tokens. DM me the staging path if you don't want to post public link.

diego: if smoke test passes, we should also run a short eval on the canonical prompt set (5 prompts) to validate outputs vs baseline (allow small fp16 noise). I'll queue that in eval-runner once artifact-bot reports success.

maria: OK doing the rename/upload now, then remap pad, then start convert. I'll post timestamps + manifest once done. thanks all :thumbsup:

artifact-bot: build started: convert-equinox13b-2234 (job id 9876).

maria: (follow-up) re-uploaded with correct extension and ran PAD remap. convert started at 2234567975. tagging @jay @katie @diego for smoke/eval.

jay: got it — will run quick smoke when convert finishes.

katie: tracking manifest job. will validate checksums and add to release bundle once all good.

maria: final — queued rollout to staging if all tests pass. will post final status later.
